business_problem: The shift to New Distribution Capability (NDC) bypassed traditional GDS buffers, sending massive search traffic directly to airlines’ systems.
solution_summary: The shift to New Distribution Capability (NDC) bypassed traditional GDS buffers, sending massive search traffic directly to airlines’ systems. Amadeus combined MongoDB's flexible document model with machine learning and Kafka to build an intelligent cache for dynamic flight data. With MongoDB, Amadeus successfully processes 20,000 searches per second with millisecond latency, while respecting airline load limits. is a major global operator in the travel industry. It’s also a business that works on a massive scale, supporting over 400 airlines and handling over 2 billion boarded passengers in one year alone. “This generates a huge amount of traffic,” explained Ali Makke, NoSQL Expert at Amadeus. It has revolutionized retail air travel by replacing legacy systems, enabling faster product launches, and providing significantly faster, more tailored booking experiences for consumers.

Upstream and downstream integrations include Kafka, CRM systems, APIs.
